<<Notice of resignation>>

Dear [Boss's Name],

I am writing to inform you that I have decided to resign my position at [Company Name], effective [last working day]. This is not an easy decision for me, but I believe it is the right step for my career development.

I would like to take this opportunity to thank you for the support and guidance you have provided me during my time at the company. I have learned a great deal and am grateful for the experiences I have had.

Please let me know if there is anything I can do to help with the transition process. I am happy to assist in any way I can to ensure a smooth handover of my responsibilities.

Thank you again for everything.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
